By acknowledging these potential influences, you can begin to explore ways to balance your decision-making style, considering both the needs of your family and your own personal goals and aspirations. This might involve seeking out diverse perspectives, practicing self-reflection, or intentionally taking calculated risks to challenge yourself and grow as a person.
